input_policy: Aggregate verified artifacts only. No raw row-level records are supplied to the AI layer.
purpose: Controlled qualitative interpretation of verified aggregate causal-analysis outputs.

verified_facts.ai_boundary: AI did not calculate or modify treatment effects, propensity scores, weights, confidence intervals, balance statistics, subgroup effects, or sensitivity results.
verified_facts.balance: Post-weighting covariate balance passed the working threshold. Rows at or above absolute SMD 0.10: 0. Maximum post-weighting absolute SMD: 0.003854.
verified_facts.confidence_interval: The 95 percent confidence interval runs from +9.12 to +14.56 percentage points.
verified_facts.identification_limitations: Causal interpretation depends on consistency, conditional exchangeability, positivity, no interference, and correct temporal ordering. Observed diagnostics do not prove absence of unmeasured confounding.
verified_facts.individual_cate: Individual-level CATE/uplift targeting was rejected after multiple validation failures. Qini and AUUC are not reported as successful final metrics.
verified_facts.overlap: Observed propensity overlap passed the project diagnostic. Poor-overlap rows: 0.
verified_facts.primary_effect: The locked primary estimator is cross-fitted AIPW. The estimated ATE is +11.84 percentage points.
verified_facts.sensitivity: Sensitivity estimates remained tightly clustered. The observed range was +11.60 to +11.84 percentage points.
verified_facts.subgroup_hte: Predefined subgroup HTE analysis was retained. The mean absolute subgroup error against synthetic truth was 1.73 percentage points.
verified_facts.synthetic_truth: Synthetic ground truth was evaluation-only and was not used for training or causal estimation. The true synthetic ATE was +10.69 percentage points.
verified_facts.weights: Extreme stabilized weights: 0. Effective sample size retained: 98.5%.
